# go-amqp-adapter

> Go adapter over amqp091-go: publish and consume RabbitMQ messages with publisher confirms, auto-reconnect, delayed retry (delay queue / DLX), and optional OpenTelemetry / correlation-id header propagation. Module: `github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter`. Package import name: `amqpadapter` (often aliased as `mq`).

Designed to pair with [go-failedjobs](https://github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-failedjobs) as a Laravel-style retry → `failed_jobs` → `queue:retry` replacement: this library does in-broker retries; permanent failures go through `WithFailHandler` (wire to `go-failedjobs.GetFailedJobHandler`).

Key rules for agents:

- Construct with `mq.New(Config, ...Option)`. `WithFailHandler` is **required** if any `QueueItem.Retry` is non-nil.
- Call `AddConsumer` / `AddConsumerN` **before** `InitConsumer`. Prefetch QoS is 1 per channel. `AddConsumerN(N)` opens N separate AMQP connections.
- In retry mode, return `mq.Retry(err)` for delayed reprocessing; return a plain error for final fail (calls fail handler, then acks).
- Publisher connects lazily on first `Publish`. `Shutdown` closes connections first, then waits for in-flight handlers.
- `*slog.Logger` satisfies `Logger`. Default logger is a no-op.

## Docs

- [Examples](https://github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/tree/main/examples): Runnable programs for consume, confirms, retry, multiple consumers, failed jobs, graceful shutdown
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/README.md): Features, quick start, config, retry, consumers, options, otel example
- [Package overview (doc.go)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/doc.go): High-level package purpose
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter): Generated Go API docs

## API source

- [Queue interface & PublishMessage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/interfaces.go): Public `Queue` contract, handlers, header builders
- [Config / QueueItem / RetryConfig](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/config.go): Connection delays and per-queue retry / consumer-only flags
- [Options](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/options.go): `WithLogger`, `WithFailHandler`, `WithPublishHeadersBuilder`, `WithConsumeHeadersExtractor`, `FailedJob`
- [New / Publish / consumers / Shutdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/queue.go): Main entry points
- [Retry helpers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/retryable.go): `Retry`, `IsRetryable`, `RetryableError`
- [otel propagation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ivan-makarenkov/go-amqp-adapter/main/otel/propagation.go): Correlation ID + W3C trace headers for publish/consume
